27 Description: According to an internet usage survey conducted in South Korea in 2024, around 81.6 percent of the respondents reported to have purchased clothing, footwear, sporting goods and accessories with internet shopping within the previous year. The second
leading items purchased with online shopping were food and groceries, with about 54.6 percent of respondents stating they purchased these online. Read more
Note(s): South Korea; September 23 to November 22, 2024; 25,509 households; 12 years and older; internet shoppers
Source(s): Gallup Korea; Ministry of Science and ICT (South Korea); NIA

Description: In 2024, e-retail sales accounted for over 47 percent of the total retail sales in South Korea. Online shopping has become prevalent in South Korea, and its growth was only accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic. Read more
Note(s): South Korea; 2020 to 2024; excluding vehicle and fuel retail
Source(s): DART; e-mart; Statistics Korea
